prompt: The client wants to know why profit fell from 2024 to 2025. Which takeaway matters most?

options.feedback: True, but it doesn't answer the client's question.

options.text: Volume was the biggest drag on profit
options.feedback: That misreads the chart: Volume added $4M; materials took away $22M.

options.text: The client should switch materials suppliers to bring costs back down
options.feedback: The chart doesn't show this. It may be true, but there is no data here to support it.

options.text: Materials costs outweighed the gains from price and volume
options.feedback: Right. Materials cost 22, against +12 from price and volume, taking profit from 50 to 35.
